$comment: Effective config of a Geant4 run (geant4 adapter 0.2.0, Geant4 program A2.4; owner adapters/geant4, versioned by probe_version). Written by geant4_run.py from the probe layered_sim (g4sim/SimProbe.hh) records on the master at the start of the run; stored once per content hash as effective_configs/<config_sha256>.json. Numbers inside geometry and sections are strings in the format of Python's float.hex(). config_sha256 is the sha256 of the JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the document without config_sha256. Validated by the adapter's scripts with contracts.schema.validate.

sources_sha256.description: sha256 of the JSON of the run record's program.sources_sha256 map

recorded.description: false: the probe did not run in state G4State_GeomClosed with couples; the run cannot upgrade

tree.description: the probe's flat list: logical_volumes, placements (with mother_logical), materials, global_field, units

environment_ref.description: sha256 of the build record (dataset paths and content hashes are recorded there once)

geant4.description: the probe's other sections: em_parameters, cuts, hadronic, general_processes, biasing, run_manager, application_state, couples, random_state_unchanged
